# Heron Atlas

Heron Atlas is a public macro research desk: official central-bank statement changes, approved event research and signed judgments with recorded outcomes. It is a static snapshot, not a live trading feed.

## Public JSON

- https://heronatlas.com/api/v1/index.json: version, build time, endpoint catalogue and source freshness.
- https://heronatlas.com/api/v1/calendar.json: Key-event ICS entries; instants UTC, date-only entries have no invented time (zh).
- https://heronatlas.com/api/v1/central-banks.json: Verified policy rates, official sources and check dates (zh).
- https://heronatlas.com/api/v1/en/calendar.json: Key-event ICS entries; instants UTC, date-only entries have no invented time (en).
- https://heronatlas.com/api/v1/en/central-banks.json: Verified policy rates, official sources and check dates (en).
- https://heronatlas.com/api/v1/en/home.json: Home policy facts, the next 72 hours, statement changes and the complete judgment ledger (en).
- https://heronatlas.com/api/v1/en/judgments.json: The existing public judgment ledger (format 1) (en).
- https://heronatlas.com/api/v1/en/statements/ecb.json: Adjacent statement pairs and sentence changes for ecb (en).
- https://heronatlas.com/api/v1/en/statements/fed.json: Adjacent statement pairs and sentence changes for fed (en).
- https://heronatlas.com/api/v1/events.json: Approved event pages, facts, results and official references (zh).
- https://heronatlas.com/api/v1/home.json: Home policy facts, the next 72 hours, statement changes and the complete judgment ledger (zh).
- https://heronatlas.com/api/v1/index.json: Schema, endpoint catalogue, page citation dates and freshness (all).
- https://heronatlas.com/api/v1/judgments.json: The existing public judgment ledger (format 1) (zh).
- https://heronatlas.com/api/v1/statements/ecb.json: Adjacent statement pairs and sentence changes for ecb (zh).
- https://heronatlas.com/api/v1/statements/fed.json: Adjacent statement pairs and sentence changes for fed (zh).
- https://heronatlas.com/api/v1/zh-hant/calendar.json: Key-event ICS entries; instants UTC, date-only entries have no invented time (zh-hant).
- https://heronatlas.com/api/v1/zh-hant/central-banks.json: Verified policy rates, official sources and check dates (zh-hant).
- https://heronatlas.com/api/v1/zh-hant/events.json: Approved event pages, facts, results and official references (zh-hant).
- https://heronatlas.com/api/v1/zh-hant/home.json: Home policy facts, the next 72 hours, statement changes and the complete judgment ledger (zh-hant).
- https://heronatlas.com/api/v1/zh-hant/judgments.json: The existing public judgment ledger (format 1) (zh-hant).
- https://heronatlas.com/api/v1/zh-hant/statements/ecb.json: Adjacent statement pairs and sentence changes for ecb (zh-hant).
- https://heronatlas.com/api/v1/zh-hant/statements/fed.json: Adjacent statement pairs and sentence changes for fed (zh-hant).

English endpoints contain only admitted English fields; English event articles are unavailable. Chinese judgment data uses the existing root judgments.json format. Null values mean unknown; date-only calendar entries have no announced instant. Source checks and build times are distinct.

## CLI & Data API

Install: pipx install https://heronatlas.com/cli/cli_anything_heronatlas-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl
Alternative: uv tool install https://heronatlas.com/cli/cli_anything_heronatlas-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl
Guide: https://heronatlas.com/cli/
Skill: https://heronatlas.com/cli/SKILL.md

## Citation

Source: Heron Atlas, <url>, as of <checked date>
Use permanent decision-pair URLs and the object checked_at date. When a source check is unknown, say unknown; a build timestamp does not verify a source.
